_comment: Hand-authored GATE 1 answer key. Copy to expected/<attribute_lower>_lineage.json, fill it in from the artifacts BEFORE the analysis session starts, and never let the analysis session edit it. Keys prefixed with '_' are ignored by verify_against_answer_key.py. Every node/hop carries an `evidence` grade: 'explicit' (a checked-in artifact names it), 'inferred' (derived from naming/sample data/wrapper order), or 'external' (lives only on the Ab Initio host, e.g. a missing .mp/.pset).
formula: direct carry: raw_orders.status -> cdc delta -> order_items.order_status -> STAGING.ORDERS.ORDER_STATUS (MERGE on order_id)

nodes._why: extract_orders.mp and orders_extract.pset are not in the repo; the raw shape is taken from data/sample/orders.dat (7 pipe-delimited columns, col 4 = status).

non_lineage_side_branches: prod_rollover_orders (downstream of the target; not part of the target's upstream chain)
